title: Reality Fracture
description: Space itself is cracked like shattered glass, each fragment reflecting a different version of the world that never was. Light bends at impossible angles along the fracture lines, and stepping too close sends vertigo crashing through your skull. Between the cracks, null particles drift like silent snow.

choices.label: Harvest the fracture edges
choices.description: Carefully peel thin membranes of compressed space from along the fracture lines.

choices.label: Collect the null particles
choices.description: Gather the drifting motes of un-matter that fall from the cracks in reality.

choices.label: Peer through for treasure
choices.description: Look through the fractured reflections for objects caught between dimensions.

choices.label: Back away
choices.description: The geometry here is wrong in ways that hurt to comprehend.
